title: College Football
description:
UCLA at Minnesota
The No. 8 UCLA Bruins (8-0) face the Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-3) at Huntington Bank Stadium for a Big Ten game. UCLA enters undefeated in eight games after shutting out Nevada 27-0, while Minnesota is coming off a 23-16 overtime defeat to Indiana.

title: College Football
description:
Cincinnati at Houston
The No. 17 Cougars meet the Bearcats at TDECU Stadium for a Big 12 game. Houston leans on nine third-down conversions from a 6-2 start, while 5-3 Cincinnati counts on three team sacks and two takeaways from an Oct. 31 game to secure a Big 12 victory.

title: College Football
description:
Iowa at Northwestern
The No. 19 Hawkeyes seek their fifth straight victory over the Wildcats. Both sides are 6-2, 3-2 Big Ten. Iowa recorded its third shutout of the season, holding Wisconsin to nine first downs and 235 yards from scrimmage in a 30-0 decision last week.
